title: POST /business/v1/guest/answer — request
$comment: RC2 §9. additionalProperties:false throughout per 'Unknown request members are rejected.' history and page_context are the only optional top-level members (RC2 §9.1 calls page_context optional explicitly; history's 'zero to 12' phrasing plus §11.2's omitted-member canonicalization rule are read here as history also being omittable when empty — see README 'Interpretations taken', item RB-1). Aggregate/cross-field rules that cannot be expressed in JSON Schema alone (10,000-char history total, turn_id uniqueness/non-collision, role alternation, subject_type/subject_id consistency) live in vectors/invariants/invariants.json.

history.$comment: RC2 §9.1: zero to 12 prior messages. Alternation/role-start-end/turn_id-uniqueness/10000-char-total are cross-field invariants (I-B02..I-B04), not expressible here.

page_context.$comment: RC2 §9.1: optional. When present, all three members are present; subject_id is nullable but never omitted (RC2 §11.2 names it the one explicitly-allowed-null member).

allOf.$comment: RC2 §9.1: every subject_type other than none requires a non-null subject_id.
